summary: A product-boundary ADR that is essentially implementable through later ADRs; its only gap is whether Kyyn supplies any standard representation for unknown or disputed values.

questions.text: Does the SDK provide a standard type or role for unknown and disputed values, or is that left entirely to KB-authored schemas?
questions.reason: An SDK type would need contract recognition, codecs and generic presentation; ADR 0001 says the KB owns its domain types and rejects a universal ontology, and ADR 0011 keeps warnings 'without automatically rejecting useful partial knowledge', but neither rules out an SDK vocabulary.
